```yaml
name: Test Cookiecutter Template

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, "3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install --system pytest
          uv pip install --system -e .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/

  test-generated-project:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        database: [tortoise, beanie]
        docker: [true, false]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          uv pip install --system cookiecutter
          cookiecutter --no-input . database=${{ matrix.database }} use_docker=${{ matrix.docker }} project_name=test_project

      - name: Validate generated project
        run: |
          cd test_project
          
          # Check file structure
          find . -type f -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./__pycache__/*" | wc -l > /dev/null
          
          # Check Python syntax
          find . -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +
          
          # Check for unreplaced template variables
          grep -r "{{cookiecutter" . || true
          
          # Install dependencies with uv
          uv sync --extra dev --frozen || echo "Some dependencies may be missing, continuing..."
          
          # Test basic imports
          python -c "import sys; print('Python version:', sys.version)"
```
